Record Class LoanDTO

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
lms.application.LoanDTO
Record Components:
loanId - the unique identifier for the loan
userId - the unique identifier for the user who borrowed the item
itemId - the unique identifier for the borrowed item
borrowDate - the date when the item was borrowed
dueDate - the date when the item is due to be returned
returnDate - the date when the item was actually returned (null if not yet returned)
returned - whether the item has been returned
fineApplied - whether a fine has been applied to this loan
overdue - whether the loan is currently overdue
overdueDays - the number of days the loan is overdue
calculatedFine - the calculated fine amount for this loan
public record LoanDTO(UUID loanId, UUID userId, UUID itemId, LocalDate borrowDate, LocalDate dueDate, LocalDate returnDate, boolean returned, boolean fineApplied, boolean overdue, long overdueDays, double calculatedFine) extends Record
Data Transfer Object (DTO) for representing a loan record.

This DTO provides a safe, immutable structure for exposing loan information from the application layer to the presentation layer.

Refactored by: Ahmad Salameh

Author:
Majd Awwad

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
